products.name: iXRD Portable Residual Stress and Retained Austenite System
products.summary: The iXRD is Proto's modular portable x-ray diffraction system for residual stress and retained austenite measurement in the laboratory, on the shop floor and in the field. A 300 W self-contained control unit, interchangeable goniometers and field stands let it reach parts from pipelines to small bores.
products.description: The iXRD measures residual stress by the sin²ψ multiple-exposure method, the same technique used on laboratory instruments, in a form that can be carried to the part. A compact 300 W control unit integrates the high-voltage supply, x-ray tube cooling, motor control and electronics with a display for kV, mA and interlocks, and provides ports for an enclosure or barrier and beacon lights for shutter and x-ray status. The goniometer is the interchangeable element: the MG40 balances size and versatility and can measure inside a 120 mm bore, the MGR40 adds an integrated phi axis for automated triaxial measurements, the MG30 reaches tighter locations, and miniature MG15 versions measure hoop stress in a 60 mm bore or axial stress in a 125 mm bore. Mounts and stands include the Cobra Arm, C-frame, the FS2 and FS4 field stands, and specialty pipeline, floor and tripod stands. Configurations extend to a Combo enclosure, Modular Mapping with a 300 × 200 mm XY stage, and an overhead Gantry. Patented residual stress mapping, automated retained austenite measurement down to 2 % in steels, x-ray elastic constant determination and XRDWIN software are available. Typical uses are pipelines, welds, shot-peened parts, power-generation components and aerospace hardware.

products.name: iXRD Mini Portable Residual Stress System
products.summary: The iXRD Mini is Proto's lower-cost portable residual stress diffractometer, with dual photon-counting detectors, a built-in 50 mm mapping slide and user-replaceable x-ray tubes. It packs into one travel case and operates at 20 W, 20 kV and 1 mA.
products.description: The iXRD Mini is the entry point to Proto's portable residual stress family, designed for affordable measurements without the footprint of a laboratory diffractometer. It uses two photon-counting x-ray detectors and a full-range goniometer for sin²ψ multiple-exposure measurements, collecting data from both positive and negative ψ tilts so shear stress is evaluated correctly. A 50 mm linear mapping slide is built in, which allows basic residual stress maps to be recorded on the spot. The x-ray tube is user-replaceable and made by Proto, with anodes of Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co and Cu available to suit steels, aluminium, titanium and other alloys. The 2θ range is 123° to 171° for residual stress and 70° to 171° for retained austenite. The goniometer weighs 2.5 kg and the power unit 8 kg, and the whole system fits in one travel case. Enclosures, radiation shields and a pendant for manual goniometer movement are offered for radiation safety and positioning. It operates from 90 to 240 VAC and runs Proto's XRDWIN software. The iXRD Mini suits quality laboratories, universities and field teams that need standards-compliant stress data at modest cost.

products.summary: The mXRD is an ultra-portable residual stress diffractometer for field use on pipelines, pressure vessels and bridges. A 2.6 kg measuring head with dual photon-counting detectors and replaceable tubes meets ASTM E915, EN 15305 and JSMS-SD-10, and the system packs into a single travel case.
products.description: The mXRD is built for residual stress work where access and transport are the constraints. The measuring head weighs 2.6 kg and measures 260 × 160 × 155 mm, while the power unit weighs 18 kg, and both fit a single travel case. Dual x-ray detectors and a full-range goniometer carry out sin²ψ multiple-exposure measurements, collecting data from positive and negative ψ tilts so shear stress is evaluated correctly and the method complies with ASTM E915, EN 15305 and JSMS-SD-10. The 40 W tube (20 kV, 2 mA) is user-replaceable and made by Proto, with anodes of Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co and Cu for different materials. The photon-counting detector array covers 29.8° of 2θ over a range of 146.8° to 165.2°, and beam apertures of 1.0 and 1.5 mm are provided. Proto positions the instrument for pipelines, pressure vessels and bridges. Options include magnetic attachment feet, a laboratory stand, a small enclosure, portable safety shields and XY mapping. The system is listed as compliant with ANSI N43.2, UL, CSA and CE, and runs from 90 to 240 VAC. It suits integrity inspection teams, fabricators and service companies that need on-site stress data.

products.summary: The LXRD is Proto's high-power laboratory and production residual stress system, built for round-the-clock operation. Enclosed versions from Standard to Gantry handle parts from 30 cm to several metres, with 1200 W goniometers, optional mapping and retained austenite measurement in as little as a minute.
products.description: The LXRD is the laboratory counterpart of the iXRD, designed as an audit station for heavy-duty, continuous operation. It is supplied in a radiation-proof enclosure with an integrated chiller and several size options. The Standard cabinet passes through a single door and takes parts up to 30 cm, with a 400 mm automated z-axis and a 1200 W MG2000 goniometer. The Widebody extends capacity to 50 cm with a 500 mm z-axis. The Modular Mapping version offers over 2 m of measurement space and a removable mapping stage for oversized components, including titanium parts that are hard to measure at low power. The Gantry is a 3.5 m walk-in enclosure that moves the goniometer rather than the part, and the Dual-Axis adds a chi rotation stage and microarea apertures for research use. Stages include XY positioning, triaxial phi rotation and an X, Y, phi mapping table; apertures run from 0.2 to 4 mm round with several rectangular options, plus microbeam apertures. Automated retained austenite measurement is available down to 1 % in steels, along with XEC determination by four-point bend and pole figures. Measurements can take as little as a minute. Typical users are manufacturers, heat-treaters and testing laboratories.

products.name: roboXRD Robotic Residual Stress Measurement System
products.summary: The roboXRD mounts Proto's iXRD measuring head on a six-axis robot with a 1210 mm reach, so residual stress can be measured on small and large parts at many angles. It is compatible with the LP200 profilometer for advanced stress mapping and positions to 10 microns.
products.description: The roboXRD adapts Proto's iXRD platform to robotic positioning. A six-axis robot with a reach of 1210 mm and an arm span of 910 mm carries the goniometer to the measurement point, which makes it practical to measure both small and large parts at a variety of angles without manual repositioning. Phi rotation covers 0 to 340 degrees and positioning accuracy is quoted as 10 microns. The system is controlled by the XRDWIN RS software package and operates from 90 to 240 VAC, single phase. Residual stress is determined with the sin²ψ multiple-exposure technique used across Proto's residual stress systems. Compatibility with the LP200 profilometer lets advanced residual stress maps be built by combining surface geometry with stress data; Proto notes that the profilometer also supports stress-versus-depth profiles and Cartesian-coordinate maps that feed its stress mapping software. Flexible configuration options allow measurements to be collected at different angles so that the required data is always obtained. The roboXRD is aimed at manufacturers and research groups that need flexible, repeatable positioning across complex shapes and surfaces, and want the movement between measurement points handled automatically rather than by hand.

products.name: AXRD Benchtop Powder Diffractometer
products.summary: The AXRD Benchtop is a 600 W powder diffractometer with decoupled motors, a selectable 143 or 191 mm goniometer radius and integrated water cooling with no external chiller. It supports phase ID, Rietveld, GID, reflectivity and non-ambient work up to 500 °C in a bench-sized footprint.
products.description: The AXRD Benchtop is designed to deliver laboratory-class powder diffraction in a footprint that fits on a bench. Its decoupled motors mean the geometry is not fixed to theta-2theta or theta-theta: the instrument can run rocking curves, glancing-incidence diffraction and theta oscillation during Bragg-Brentano scans, and it is described as the only benchtop diffractometer with an optional parallel-beam optic and long Soller slit for proper GID. The goniometer radius can be set to 143 mm for higher flux and faster measurements or 191 mm for narrower peaks, with FWHM resolution better than 0.05° 2θ at 143 mm and 0.03° at 191 mm. The 600 W tube is cooled by an integrated tank, pump and heat exchanger, so no external chiller is needed. products.description: The mScan XRF determines elemental composition and maps element distribution on samples of many sizes and materials. The element range runs from sodium to americium, and from carbon to americium when specialised detectors are fitted. A 15 micron spot size gives high spatial resolution, and a fast silicon drift detector provides the energy resolution and short collection times needed for mapping. Measurement areas can be a single point, a line, a rectangle or a set of points, so a rock section or a circuit board can be scanned and presented as multi-element maps. A stable vacuum pump with quick pump-down speeds sample loading, a helium flow-through option improves data for light elements, and a live-feed video microscope inside the enclosure confirms the analysed area. The XYZ sample stage moves at 100 mm/s and a joystick provides rapid targeting. The cabinet is radiation-protected and large enough for bigger samples. Proto positions the instrument for materials science, quality control and research, and software controls acquisition and mapping. It suits geology, electronics failure analysis, coatings and materials laboratories that need compositional detail on small features.

ar.description: nSpec XRF مطياف ED-XRF مكتبي مخصص للفحص الروتيني ومراقبة الجودة لا للتصوير. يمتد نطاق العناصر من الصوديوم إلى الأمريسيوم، ومن الكربون إلى الأمريسيوم بكواشف متخصصة. وتحسّن حجرة التفريغ حدود الكشف للعناصر الخفيفة، ويتوفر خيار حجرة غاز الهيليوم حيث لا يلائم التفريغ العينة. وتستوعب الخزانة المحمية من الإشعاع عينات حتى 50 × 50 × 50 mm، ويتيح الباب الآلي دمج الجهاز في نظام مناولة عينات روبوتي بحيث يعمل كمحطة في خط آلي. وصُممت البرمجيات وأدوات التحكم لتشغيل مباشر، وتُدمج ميزات الأمان في الخزانة. وتذكر Proto مراقبة العمليات في الإسمنت والمعادن والدهانات والطلاءات كمجالات الاستخدام الرئيسية، وهو ما يناسب مصانع الإسمنت ومعالجة المعادن وإنتاج الطلاءات والمختبرات التحليلية العامة حيث تلزم فحوصات تركيب سريعة. أما لتحليل البقع الصغيرة ورسم خرائط العناصر فإن mScan XRF من الشركة المصنّعة نفسها هو الطراز المقابل، بينما nSpec XRF هو الخيار الأبسط لتحليل التركيب الكلي للعينات المجهّزة.

products.name: Laue-COS Benchtop Single-Crystal Orientation System
products.summary: The Laue-COS Benchtop is a compact Laue back-reflection system for orienting single crystals such as scintillators, optical crystals, piezoelectrics, minerals and substrates. It determines orientation to 0.1° using an in-house scintillation detector, and is available in horizontal and vertical versions.
products.description: The Laue-COS Benchtop determines the orientation of single-crystal materials in seconds without the space demands of a conventional Laue instrument. It is intended for production and research laboratories that grow, cut or inspect scintillation crystals, non-linear optical crystals, piezoelectrics, minerals and wafers. Orientation accuracy is 0.1°. The instrument has no consumables, such as detector gases, and uses a Proto tungsten x-ray tube. Its back-reflection detector is a scintillation design made in house, sensitive across 4 to 30 keV, with 2080 × 2080 pixels at a 61 micron pixel size over a 127 × 127 mm area; binning shortens collection times. Two configurations are offered. The horizontal version carries an X,Y stage with 4 inch travel per axis and accepts a manual goniometer or a crystal-cutting goniometer, so a crystal can be reoriented and moved straight to the saw without being removed from its mount. The vertical version is aimed at thin plates and wafers, including diamond plates, and adds a laser focusing system that can reveal subtle wedge shapes. Motorised joystick-controlled stages are optional. XRDWIN Laue software handles simulation, indexing and reorientation, with Crystallography Open Database integration.

ar.summary: Laue-COS Benchtop نظام Laue مدمج للانعكاس الخلفي لتحديد اتجاه البلورات المفردة مثل المتلألئات والبلورات البصرية والمواد الكهرضغطية والمعادن والركائز. يحدد الاتجاه بدقة 0.1° باستخدام كاشف تلألؤ مصنّع داخليًا، ويتوفر بنسختين أفقية ورأسية.
ar.description: يحدد Laue-COS Benchtop اتجاه المواد البلورية المفردة في ثوانٍ دون المساحة التي يتطلبها جهاز Laue تقليدي. وهو مخصص لمختبرات الإنتاج والبحث التي تنمّي أو تقطع أو تفحص بلورات التلألؤ والبلورات البصرية اللاخطية والمواد الكهرضغطية والمعادن والرقائق. دقة الاتجاه 0.1°. ولا يحتوي الجهاز على مواد استهلاكية مثل غازات الكاشف، ويستخدم أنبوب أشعة سينية من التنغستن من Proto. وكاشف الانعكاس الخلفي فيه بتصميم تلألؤ مصنّع داخليًا، حساس في المدى من 4 إلى 30 keV، بدقة 2080 × 2080 بكسل وحجم بكسل 61 ميكرون على مساحة 127 × 127 mm؛ ويقصّر التجميع (binning) أزمنة الجمع. ويُعرض تكوينان. تحمل النسخة الأفقية منصة X وY بمدى حركة 4 بوصات لكل محور وتقبل مقياس زوايا يدويًا أو مقياس زوايا لقطع البلورات، بحيث يمكن إعادة توجيه البلورة ونقلها مباشرة إلى المنشار دون إزالتها من حاملها. أما النسخة الرأسية فموجهة للصفائح الرقيقة والرقائق، بما فيها صفائح الألماس، وتضيف نظام تبئير بالليزر يمكنه كشف أشكال إسفينية دقيقة. وتتوفر منصات محركة يُتحكم بها بعصا التحكم اختياريًا. ويتولى برنامج XRDWIN Laue المحاكاة والفهرسة (indexing) وإعادة التوجيه، مع تكامل مع Crystallography Open Database.

products.name: SC-1 MAX Single-Crystal X-ray Diffractometer
products.summary: The SC-1 MAX is Proto's advanced single-crystal diffractometer for demanding experiments such as protein crystallography. It combines a liquid gallium or indium MetalJet source, a kappa goniometer, a photon-counting EIGER2 detector and cryo cooling from 80 to 500 K, with magnetic mounts for quick crystal changes.
products.description: The SC-1 MAX targets experiments where data resolution and source brightness decide the outcome, including protein crystallography. Its x-ray source is the MetalJet D2+, which uses a liquid gallium or indium anode and delivers the highest x-ray flux in a laboratory system through very high brightness and an 80 micron beam, with performance the manufacturer compares to synchrotrons. The goniometer is a proprietary kappa design with a high-precision, high-accuracy bearing, and crystals are mounted on magnetic goniometer heads and bases for quick changeover. Detection uses direct capture of x-ray photons with zero noise and very wide dynamic range, with a DECTRIS EIGER2 detector shown on the product page and CdTe sensors available for higher quantum efficiency at harder wavelengths. Advanced multilayer optics provide beam intensity, and cryo coolers cover 80 to 500 kelvin. Novel data collection algorithms aim to maximise completeness and redundancy in the shortest possible time. The SC-1 MAX is aimed at structural biology and chemical crystallography groups in universities, institutes and pharmaceutical research that want in-house access to high-quality diffraction data. Related models in the same family are the SC-1 and SC-1 HP.

products.name: Electropolisher Model 8818-V3
products.summary: The Proto Electropolisher 8818-V3 is a compact 8 kg unit for etching and polishing metal surfaces without introducing cold-work stress. It removes thin layers so residual stress and retained austenite can be re-measured at each depth, in the laboratory or on large parts in the field.
products.description: Residual stress changes with depth, and mechanical grinding would alter the very stress state being measured. The 8818-V3 removes material electrolytically, so layers can be taken off without cold-working the surface and stress or retained austenite can then be re-measured at each depth. It also serves for general metallurgical preparation. The unit weighs 8 kg, measures 35 × 30 × 15 cm and offers dual-mode etching and polishing. Output is 0 to 65 VDC at up to 10 A from a 90 to 265 VAC input, with a timer that handles seconds, minutes and hours up to 300 hours, and the pump and electrodes switch off automatically at the end of a polish, signalled by a buzzer. A stainless steel self-priming gear pump with a brushless motor circulates electrolyte, flow is electronically adjustable, and a stainless tank with chill pockets holds the solution. Protection includes fused input and automatic overpower output protection. Replaceable spot tips of 6, 9, 12 and 15 mm, alligator and magnetic ground clips, a manual and an operation video are supplied. Optional accessories include a stand, travel case, custom electrodes and masking kit; Proto's non-toxic Electrolyte A is separate.

products.name: XRDWIN 2.0 Residual Stress, Laue and Powder Diffraction Software
products.summary: XRDWIN 2.0 is Proto's data collection and analysis software for its residual stress, Laue orientation and powder diffraction instruments. The stress package covers sin²ψ regression, triaxial analysis, patented stress mapping, XEC determination and retained austenite, with add-in modules for pole figures and more.
products.description: XRDWIN 2.0 runs every Proto XRD instrument and comes in dedicated packages for residual stress, Laue orientation and powder diffraction. The residual stress package performs linear and elliptical regression of d versus sin²ψ data with error analysis, supports psi and omega geometries, and offers peak-fitting routines including parabolic, Gaussian, Pearson VII, Cauchy, centroid and mid-chord, with the Dolle-Hauk method for ψ+ and ψ−. Triaxial routines, manual or automated, give the stress tensor, principal stress, maximum shear and equivalent stress. Residual stress mapping uses square, rectangular and circular grids or hand-picked points with patented multi-level 3D display, map algebra and before-and-after comparison, and can combine stress, peak width, retained austenite and hardness in one map. Utilities cover principal stress calculation, material removal and penetration depth corrections, x-ray elastic constant determination and remote access over a network. Add-in modules include pole figure, expert system, database management, inline inspection stress monitor, strain gage monitor and four-peak retained austenite measurement. The Laue version provides pattern simulation, automated indexing and a production mode for orienting components such as turbine blades, and the powder package, XRDWIN PD with PDAnalysis, covers phase identification, Rietveld refinement and a 21 CFR Part 11 compliant option.

ar.description: يشغّل XRDWIN 2.0 كل أجهزة Proto لحيود الأشعة السينية ويأتي في حزم مخصصة للإجهاد المتبقي وتحديد اتجاه Laue وحيود المساحيق. تجري حزمة الإجهاد المتبقي انحدارًا خطيًا وإهليلجيًا لبيانات d مقابل sin²ψ مع تحليل الخطأ، وتدعم هندستي psi وomega، وتوفر إجراءات مطابقة القمم تشمل القطع المكافئ والغاوسي وPearson VII وCauchy والمركز الثقلي ومنتصف الوتر، مع طريقة Dolle-Hauk لـ ψ+ وψ−. وتعطي الإجراءات ثلاثية المحاور، اليدوية أو الآلية، موتر الإجهاد والإجهاد الرئيسي وأقصى قص والإجهاد المكافئ. ويستخدم رسم خرائط الإجهاد المتبقي شبكات مربعة ومستطيلة ودائرية أو نقاطًا مختارة يدويًا مع عرض ثلاثي الأبعاد متعدد المستويات مسجّل ببراءة اختراع وجبر الخرائط والمقارنة قبل وبعد، ويمكنه الجمع بين الإجهاد وعرض القمة والأوستنيت المتبقي والصلادة في خريطة واحدة. وتشمل الأدوات المساعدة حساب الإجهاد الرئيسي وتصحيحات إزالة المادة وعمق الاختراق وتحديد الثابت المرن للأشعة السينية والوصول عن بُعد عبر الشبكة. وتشمل الوحدات الإضافية الأشكال القطبية والنظام الخبير وإدارة قواعد البيانات ومراقب إجهاد الفحص المباشر على الخط (inline) ومراقب مقياس الانفعال (strain gage) وقياس الأوستنيت المتبقي بأربع قمم. وتوفر نسخة Laue محاكاة الأنماط والفهرسة الآلية ووضع إنتاج لتحديد اتجاه مكونات مثل ريش التوربينات، وتغطي حزمة المساحيق XRDWIN PD مع PDAnalysis تحديد الأطوار وتنقيح Rietveld وخيارًا متوافقًا مع 21 CFR Part 11.
